messages:
Lena (AE): Arbora Health RFI arrived. Need capability matrix, KMS/HSM details, EU data residency mapping, POC timeline, and pricing. Legal asked for SOC2 and encryption specifics. Can SE/Finance assist?
Marco (SE): I can draft the capability matrix and KMS section. Quick Q: do they insist on on-prem private control plane or is VPC acceptable with tenant isolation? Also what perf targets for the POC?
Lena (AE): They prefer private but will accept VPC if tenancy guaranteed. Targets: ~200 qps embeddings, ~50 qps chat, P50 <120ms. Pricing: reserved commit vs burst comparison + ballpark numbers.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Starting RFI answers and a 3-week POC runbook (week1: connectivity & auth; week2: perf & embeddings; week3: security review + handoff). Requesting a representative test dataset from the customer.
Sam (Finance): Send expected token/embedding volumes; I'll model two price options. Note: embedding quantization profile could cut costs ~25-35%—call that out.
ops-bot: uploaded capmatrix_arbora_v1.pdf and rfi_draft_arbora.docx — https://files.redwood/capmatrix_arbora_v1.pdf
Marco (SE): Drafted KMS blurb: "Customer-managed keys supported; HSM-wrapping optional (cloud HSM or customer HSM); envelope encryption; rotation options."
Priya (Solutions Eng): Security flagged FedRAMP request. We're not FedRAMP certified. Propose a 9–12 month FedRAMP roadmap + interim compensating controls (private VPC, continuous logging, SSP readiness).
Lena (AE): Ok. Next steps: Marco attach KMS + runbook, Priya finalize matrix and RFI answers, Sam produce pricing models. Target to send packet by EOD Thursday. Flag blockers (EU mapping, HSM certs) here immediately.
Sam (Finance): Will upload numbers tomorrow afternoon.
Lena (AE): Thanks team — I'll consolidate and send to procurement.
